text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Atony (Postpartum). The combination of uterine tenderness, decreased bowel sounds, and a history of a prolonged labor with a large infant (11 lbs) strongly suggests uterine atony, which can lead to urinary retention and subsequent abdominal distension. I will request a urine analysis and a post-void residual measurement to confirm urinary retention. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis; REQUEST TEST: Post_Void_Residual.
